title: Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP adds AWS CloudFormation and Console support for snapshots, clones, and data replication
summary: Discover more about what's new at AWS with Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP adds AWS CloudFormation and Console support for snapshots, clones, and data replication
body_markdown:
[Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP](https://aws.amazon.com/fsx/netapp-ontap/) now lets you snapshot, clone, and replicate your data directly from the Amazon FSx Console and AWS CloudFormation. Today’s launch allows you to protect and copy your ONTAP data using the same AWS tools that you use across the rest of your AWS environments, with a few clicks in the AWS console or as part of your infrastructure-as-code workflows.


FSx for ONTAP is the first and only storage service that allows you to launch and run fully managed, fully featured ONTAP file systems in the cloud. Previously, you could only set up and manage snapshots, volume clones, and SnapMirror replication via the ONTAP CLI or REST API. Starting today, you can also use the Amazon FSx Console, Amazon FSx API, and AWS CloudFormation, in addition to the ONTAP CLI and REST API, to manage these resources.


AWS Console and CloudFormation support for these resources are available in all AWS Regions where FSx for ONTAP is available. To learn more, visit the[FSx for NetApp ONTAP user guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/getting-started.html) and the[Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP product page](https://aws.amazon.com/fsx/netapp-ontap/) .
